title: A normal casual Monday chat that drifts into one small ask

chat.label: chat
chat.goal: Just chatting at the start of the week: say hey, mention you barely slept because of the board meeting next week, react to whatever it says, then ask what your Wednesday looks like. Casual, not teasing.

judge: From the very first reply the bot feels like a friend with personality: a real hello with a little life, a genuine reaction (and maybe an opinion or a light tease) when he mentions the board meeting, and a crisp Wednesday rundown. Not a help desk, not cringe.
